normative_extracts.quote: Each task in the task queue runs to completion, followed immediately by performing a microtask checkpoint before the next timer task executes.
Works like advanceTimersByTime, but will await queued microtasks after each timer callback runs.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Fake timers intercept Date, setTimeout, and requestAnimationFrame into a deterministic min-heap; async advancement interleaves macrotask execution with microtask draining to preserve Promise resolution order.

production_failures.symptom: Debounced search test fails intermittently in CI despite passing locally
production_failures.root_cause: Test used real setTimeout(300) and asserted after 310ms, which failed whenever CI CPU load delayed the timer callback beyond 310ms.
production_failures.mitigation: Enable fake timers and advance virtual time with advanceTimersByTimeAsync(300).

production_failures.symptom: Test hangs until 5000ms timeout when combining fake timers with waitFor()
production_failures.root_cause: waitFor() schedules retry polls with setTimeout, which never fires when fake timers freeze the clock.
production_failures.mitigation: Pass advanceTimers to Testing Library or use advanceTimersByTimeAsync instead of waitFor polling.
